relations.text: Dickiesブランドの事業を売却する契約(2025年9月)
relations.text_en: Agreed to sell the Dickies brand business (September 2025)

source.label: VF Corp 10-K(2026年3月期)
source.quote: On September 15, 2025, VF entered into a definitive agreement with Bluestar Alliance LLC to sell the Dickies ® brand business ("Dickies").

relations.text: Spinnovaが、公表済みのブランド協業先としてVF傘下のIcebreakerを挙げる
relations.text_en: Spinnova lists VF's Icebreaker brand among its published brand collaborations

source.label: Spinnova F-1/A(2026年9月)
source.quote: Our published brand collaborations today include Adidas, H&M, the VF Corporation brand Icebreaker, Marimekko, BESTSELLER, Bergans of Norway, Insider, Puma, Armedangels, PVH (Tommy Hilfiger) and ECCO.

source.label: Compass Diversified 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: 5.11 competes against activewear, outdoor and specialty apparel brands such as Nike, Under Armour, The North Face, Patagonia, Lululemon, Arc'teryx, Carhartt, Propper and Fecheimer Brothers.
